summary.text: Dan Stec is a Republican state senator who represents New York State Senate District 45 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Stec is an engineer and U.S. Navy veteran who served in the State Assembly from 2013 to 2021 and has been a state senator since 2021; he is the Republican and Conservative Party candidate.

paragraphs.text: Dan Stec was born in Queensbury, New York, and served in the U.S. Navy.

He earned a B.S. in chemical engineering from Clarkson University and an M.B.A. from the University of Rhode Island, and his career experience includes working as a nuclear engineer with the U.S. Navy.
Stec represented Assembly District 114 from 2013 to 2021, succeeding Janet Duprey (R), and has served in the State Senate since 2021, succeeding Betty Little (R).

In the 2025-2026 session he is ranking member of the Internet and Technology Committee and the Environmental Conservation Committee, and is also assigned to the Education, Health, Rules, and Veterans, Homeland Security and Military Affairs committees.
In the November 3, 2026 general election, Stec faces Melissa Seale (D / Working Families Party).
